records.change: Retyped '4-amino-2-hydroxy-N,N,N-trimethyl-4-oxobutan-1-aminium chloride' from EXACT_SYNONYM to REJECTED_LABEL, preserving its original chebi_synonym_review source (#1003; #669). Official ChEBI:48601 assigns this exact IUPAC name to carnitinamide chloride (C7H17N2O2.Cl), whereas CHEBI:17126 carnitine is C7H15NO3. The amide name survived this record's 2026-07-05 correction of the erroneous CHEBI:48601 mapping. Sources inspected 2026-11-01: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ontologies/chebi/terms?obo_id=CHEBI:48601 ; https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ontologies/chebi/terms?obo_id=CHEBI:17126 . Preserved the current identifier, parent mapping, status and occurrences; unresolved salt/CAS/stereochemistry questions are not adjudicated, and no scientific or release approval is asserted.
